name: railway

patches.old:
download() {
  file="$1"
  url="$2"
  touch "$file"

  if has curl; then
    cmd="curl --fail --silent --location --output $file $url"
  elif has wget; then
    cmd="wget --quiet --output-document=$file $url"
  elif has fetch; then
    cmd="fetch --quiet --output=$file $url"
  else
    error "No HTTP download program (curl, wget, fetch) found, exiting…"
    return 1
  fi

  $cmd && return 0 || rc=$?

  error "Command failed (exit code $rc): ${BLUE}${cmd}${NO_COLOR}"
  printf "\n" >&2
  info "This is likely due to railway not yet supporting your configuration."
  info "If you would like to see a build for your configuration,"
  info "please create an issue requesting a build for ${MAGENTA}${TARGET}${NO_COLOR}:"
  info "${BOLD}${UNDERLINE}https://github.com/railwayapp/cli/issues/new/${NO_COLOR}"
  return $rc
}

notes: Converts the official upstream installer; upstream source is fetched at a fixed commit rather than vendored.
Core CLI installation only; optional cloud-agent setup is not requested. Uses official musl release for the Linux x86_64 target.

validation_scope.runtime_scope: CLI installation and local operation; no remote service, cluster or deployment is claimed.
